title: 第五章 不懂术数的巫师不是好巫师第六章 莫宁是难得的人才
slug: 从巫师学徒到万界征服者
content_zh:
莫宁手中的墨管笔，继续笔走龙蛇。
“学院分配的宿舍虽然有些简陋，但研究环境比摇摇晃晃的马车好太多了。
“说真的，我真怀念圣枪王国王室图书馆里的半年时间，每天都可以沉浸在知识的海洋里。
“据说图书馆的藏书超过八万册，可惜我只阅读了其中少部分。”
他停止了废话，开始进入了正题。
“这几天我正好有几个新点子，现在总算是安顿下来了，我有点迫不及待地想验证新想法。
“我有一种预感，这次或许可以对次零级巫术【闪光】的架构做出一点优化。”
所谓的“次零级巫术”，可以简单理解为删减版的零级巫术。
在正统巫师术语中，它们常被略带调侃地称为——戏法。
因为次零级巫术威力微弱，难以直接用于战斗，如同魔法世界里的儿童玩具。
但正因其结构简单、能量需求极低，即便未凝聚灵环、精神力微薄的学徒，也能通过精确的手势、咒音或媒介勉强驱动。
几乎所有巫师学徒，窥探魔力运作原理的第一扇窗口，都是次零级巫术。
而【闪光】，正是一个最基础的光系次零级戏法。
它的效果仅是瞬间爆发刺目强光，除了致盲片刻，几无他用。
可它却是研究“光元素激发-汇聚-释放”过程的经典模板。
莫宁的笔尖快速移动，流泻出更多看似随意、实则精心铺垫的文字：
“第一个想法是重构【闪光】基础能流脉冲的谐振模型，以期提升光能转化效率。
“第二个设想是改良启动咒文的共鸣频率，或许可以小幅度提升光元素的聚集速度。
“第三个……”
笔尖微微一顿，墨水在纸面洇开一个小点，仿佛思考在此凝结。

随即文字再度淌出：
“第三个设想，源于今日穿过‘幽静密林小径’时的经历，这个神奇的巫术给我带来了一个巨大的灵感。
“既然环境介质可以如此精妙地影响感知与空间感，那么【闪光】术是否也能超越单纯的‘光强爆发’，转而追求对受术者‘视觉信息处理层面’的短暂干预？”
“具体而言，尝试在光爆的瞬间……”
*****
黑塔深处。
某个被层层符文隐匿的密室内。
无数细微的魔力丝线在虚空中穿梭、交织，最终汇聚成数百个悬浮在半空中的朦胧光球，如同倒悬的星河。
一位身着灰袍的女学徒，正仰首凝视着这片“星河”。
她袍袖边缘，三道银线闪烁着冷冽的光泽——三级学徒。
在黑塔学院内的序列中，已然算得上是管理层。
当然。
管理的对象不可能是巫师，而是数量以“万”为单位的学徒。
最精确的数字是——58419名。
相比仅仅两千出头的巫师，学徒的数量多了近三十倍。
从这个惊人的比例亦可以窥探出来，晋升巫师是何其艰难之事。
女学徒的形貌与寻常人类迥异，容颜堪称精致绝伦，肌肤透着月光般的冷白，身形曲线在宽大袍服下依然惊心动魄。
最引人注目的，是她额前一支玲珑剔透的琥珀色小角，以及那双比精灵更为修长尖锐的耳朵。
content_en:
The ink pen in Mourning's hand continued to write like a dragon or a snake.
“Although the dormitories assigned by the college are a bit crude, the research environment is much better than a rickety carriage.
"To be honest, I really miss spending half a year in the royal library of the Holy Spear Kingdom, where I could immerse myself in the ocean of knowledge every day.
"It is said that the library has more than 80,000 books, but unfortunately I have only read a few of them."
He stopped talking nonsense and got down to business.
“I happened to have a few new ideas in the past few days, and now that I have finally settled down, I can’t wait to test out the new ideas.
“I have a hunch that maybe we can make some optimizations to the structure of Sub-Zero Witchcraft [Flash] this time. "
The so-called "sub-zero witchcraft" can be simply understood as an abridged version of zero-level witchcraft.
In orthodox wizarding terminology, they are often called, somewhat jokingly, tricks.
Because sub-zero witchcraft is weak and difficult to use directly in combat, it is like a children's toy in the magical world.
However, due to its simple structure and extremely low energy requirements, even apprentices who have not gathered a spiritual ring and have meager mental power can barely drive it through precise gestures, incantations or media.
For almost all wizard apprentices, the first window into how magic works is sub-zero witchcraft.
And [Flash] is just the most basic light system sub-zero trick.
Its effect is only an instantaneous burst of dazzling bright light, which has little use except blinding for a moment.
But it is a classic template for studying the process of "light element excitation-concentration-release".
Moning's pen tip moved quickly, pouring out more words that seemed random but were actually carefully prepared:
“The first idea is to reconstruct the resonance model of the [flash] basic energy flow pulse in order to improve the light energy conversion efficiency.
“The second idea is to improve the resonance frequency of the activated spell, which may slightly increase the gathering speed of light elements.
"The third..."
The pen tip paused slightly, and a small dot of ink spread on the paper, as if thoughts were condensed here.
Then the text flowed out again:
"The third idea comes from my experience today when I walked through the "Secret Forest Trail". This magical witchcraft brought me a huge inspiration.
"Since environmental media can affect perception and spatial sense so subtly, can the [flash] technique also go beyond a simple 'burst of light intensity' and instead pursue a brief intervention in the subject's 'visual information processing level'?"
"Specifically, try to do it at the moment of light explosion..."
*****
Deep in the Black Tower.
In a secret room hidden by layers of runes.
Countless tiny magical threads shuttled and intertwined in the void, eventually converging into hundreds of hazy light balls suspended in mid-air, like an upside-down galaxy.
A female apprentice in gray robe was looking up at the "Galaxy".
On the edge of her robe sleeves, three silver threads shone with a cold luster - a third-level apprentice.
In the sequence within the Black Tower Academy, it can already be regarded as the management.
certainly.
The objects of management cannot be wizards, but apprentices whose number is measured in "ten thousand".
The most accurate number is 58,419.
Compared to wizards who were only in their early 2,000s, the number of apprentices was nearly thirty times greater.
From this astonishing ratio, we can also see how difficult it is to become a wizard.
The appearance of the female apprentice is very different from that of ordinary humans. Her appearance is exquisite, her skin is as cold and white as moonlight, and her body curves are still thrilling under the large robes.
The most eye-catching thing is the exquisite amber horn on her forehead and the ears that are slender and sharper than those of elves.
